mostWorthwhile.text: Building the membrane bag was most worthwhile because its picture showed how a boundary creates an inside and an outside.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the two transport proteins felt somewhat repetitive: their pictures and the goal made both placements straightforward.

surprise.text: I was surprised that oxygen can cross the lipid itself, while water channels and sugar carriers provide other routes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the pairings clear, even if they did not explain every mechanism.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how this simple cell model connects to tissues and organs, though this chapter's choices were mostly predictable.
